parts.t: Central Abbotsford takes in City Centre around Mill Lake, the Historic Downtown and the UDistrict around the University of the Fraser Valley. All three have their own neighbourhood plans. This is an MLS® area with no official City boundary, so schools and parks here are placed by address.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 10, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Abbotsford.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

parts.t: Central Abbotsford has three of the City’s four neighbourhood plans.
The City Centre Neighbourhood Plan (Bylaw 2913-2019) aims for a more populated, walkable neighbourhood at the heart of the urban area.
The Historic Downtown Neighbourhood Plan (Bylaw 2920-2019) values the area’s heritage and small, independent businesses.
The UDistrict Neighbourhood Plan covers 365 acres around the UFV campus and was adopted in May 2018.
